item.title: I Switched to Self-Cleaning Litter Boxes in My Home, and I Wish I
item.description: Automated, self-cleaning litter boxes are easier and cleaner than traditional litter boxes, and they can even be cheaper in the long run. I tested models like the Whisker Litter-Robot ($799) and Petkit Purobot Ultra ($900) with our shy, anxious cat, and I will never go back to standard litter boxes again.
